endorsements.name: David Padilla Alvarado
endorsements.label: CVE-2024-10454
endorsements.description: Clickjacking vulnerability in Clibo Manager v1.1.9.12 in the '/public/login' directory, a login panel. This vulnerability occurs due to the absence of an X-Frame-Options server-side header. An attacker could overlay a transparent iframe to perform click hijacking on victims.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 6.1)
